To satisfy these requirements, a reconfiguration is proposed:
- The Object Recognition service will be moved from the edge node N4 to the cloud node N7.
- The Scene Processing service will be moved from the cloud node N6 to the cloud node N7.
- The AR Rendering service will be moved from the edge node N4 to the edge node N3.
